_comment: Guided tour for the ndX ranking panel (emtk; the steps name the invisible Qt anchors ndxplorer.ui.vizrank_panel keeps over the emtk controls). Steps point at real controls and wait for the user to press them; read by chisurf.gui.widgets.tools.guided_tour.

steps.title: What this panel does
steps.text:
Every pair of parameters is a possible plot. This panel scores all of them and lists them best first, so you look at the few that show something instead of paging through hundreds.

Four steps.

steps.title: Choose what "informative" means
steps.text: Separation (default) finds the views where the bursts fall into clearly separated islands: donor-only, acceptor-only and FRET species in E vs S, a dynamic population off the static FRET line. Correlation finds parameters that move together. Classes appears when there are gates or clusters and finds views that keep them apart.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: The table fills while it computes, best rows at the top. Pause stops it and Start continues; closing the panel pauses too.

steps.title: Click a row to see that plot
steps.text: Selecting a row sets the axes of the main plot. Islands says how many populations the view splits into, and the line under the table what the score means in numbers. Picking axes by hand in the plot selects the matching row here.
